english_text: We have captured the enemy base!
Our brothers are caught in the crossfire!
czech_text: Naši bratři jsou v křížové palbě!

english_text: The clans stand under one banner, mine!
czech_text: Kmeny stojí pod jedinou korouhví, mou!

english_text: Ancestors, we honor you with this victory!
The Spartan King will fight no more!
The enemy base will soon be ours!
Our men return to fight again!
czech_text: Naši muži se vracejí do boje!

english_text: The battle is ending! Fight on!
There is no time for rest!
Defeat is coming! Meet it head on!
czech_text: Blíží se porážka! Postavte se jí čelem!

english_text: I spit at Caesar and Rome!
czech_text: Plivu na Caesara i na Řím!

english_text: United we stand, divided we fall!
Gods, hear me! We will be victorious!
Watch your step! These lands are trap-ridden!
czech_text: Dávejte pozor! Tahle země je plná pastí!

english_text: The gods smile on the victorious!
Capture their base or cut them down!
czech_text: Dobuďte jejich základnu, nebo je pobijte!

english_text: The Valkyries have come for me!
The Iceni mourn the loss of their queen.
May the gods grant you a warrior's rest, Alexander!
czech_text: Ať ti bohové dopřejí válečnický odpočinek, Alexandře!

english_text: Caesar is dead at long last!
Our base is under attack! We must stop them!
czech_text: Útočí na naši základnu! Musíme je zastavit!

english_text: The clans are ready to fight!
Death has come for the enemy commander!
czech_text: Pro nepřátelského velitele si přišla smrt!

english_text: Defeat! The enemy holds our base!
We will rise again, stronger than ever!
czech_text: Povstaneme znovu, silnější než kdy dřív!

english_text: The gods are watching! Do not disappoint them!
Time is short! Make them bleed!
czech_text: Času je málo! Pusťte jim krev!
Muži se hrnou pod mou korouhev!

english_text: You can rest when you're dead! FIGHT!
We have our victory and the enemy base!
